entry:

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Spanish 2
entry:
Prerequisite: Spaans 1 or proof of A2 or A2+ level (CEFR) recommended.

If having A2 level cannot be proven, a placement test in early September (first semester intake) or late January (second semester intake) is recommended before taking this course.

This course is offered in both semesters.

entry: The course is part of the BA Latin American Studies program. It is open to students from other programs. Knowledge of the history of the region is recommended.

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Latin America in the World
entry: This course is open to BA students who have taken at least one course in a relevant area of specialization (e.g. in Latin American studies) in the first year. This is also offered as part of the Minor in Latin American studies and also open students wishing to take it as an individual elective.

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Research Methods Latin American Studies
entry: Solo como asignaturas obligatoria para Estudios Latinoamericanos u otros programas de Bachelor en la Universidad de Leiden u otra universidad neerlandesa. Este curso está abierto a estudiantes que tengan un buen dominio de la lengua española y/o un dominio pasivo de la lengua española con un dominio activo del portugués.

Alleen als hoofdvak voor Latijns-Amerikastudies of andere bacheloropleidingen aan de Universiteit Leiden of een andere Nederlandse universiteit. Deze cursus staat open voor studenten die een goede beheersing van de Spaanse taal hebben en/of een passieve beheersing van de Spaanse taal met een actieve beheersing van het Portugees.

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Public Policies in Latin America
entry: Open to students enrolled in relevant BA or MA programmes, including International Relations and Latin American Studies. No formal prerequisites are required. The course assumes an interest in public policy, development, and Latin America.

Open voor studenten die ingeschreven zijn in relevante BA- of MA-programma’s, waaronder International Relations en Latijns-Amerikastudies. Er zijn geen formele toelatingseisen. De cursus veronderstelt interesse in publieke beleidsvorming, ontwikkeling en Latijns-Amerika.

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Bachelor thesis seminar
entry:
Het scriptieseminar is verplicht voor alle bachelorstudenten Latijns-Amerikastudies die gaan werken aan hun BA-eindwerkstuk. Het seminar staat niet open voor andere studenten.
Deze activiteit bestaat uit een semestrieel programma met 5 sessies in totaal. Aanwezigheid is verplicht en de participatie is onderworpen aan evaluatie. Er worden twee seminars parallel gegeven, die elk worden gecoördineerd en geleid door één docent uit de betreffende discipline (Moderne Geschiedenis, Culturele Analyse). Voor Taalkunde wordt het seminar ingericht op individueel niveau.

reviewedAnnualModules.title: BA Buitenlandverblijf S2
entry: Students must have successfully completed their first year of study within BA Latin American Studies in accordance with the established study plan, achieving the Propedeuse distribution (60EC).

reviewedAnnualModules.title: Bilingualism in the Hispanic and Portuguese Speaking World (Latin American Studies)
entry:
Students need to have completed the Propedeuse in Latin American Studies. This course can be followed by students in both Spanish and Portuguese tracks. 
Non-major students who want to take this course should contact the lecturer.

annualAccounting: BA-LAS-1-V 40 EC plus Spanish 1 and 2 at 10 EC each. BA-LAS-2 current annual listing allocates 10 EC required and 20 EC Spanish route to S1 and BLV-S2 at 30 EC in S2. BA-LAS-3 currently allocates 15 required, 5 restricted choice, 10 thesis and 30 open. The seminar carries zero additional EC. These current annual group totals do not establish the revised entrant pathway.
materialConflict: The PRG footnote in the same annual BA-LAS product expressly moves study abroad to year two semester one for students starting in 2026–2027. BA-LAS-2-K and BLV-S2 explicitly describe semester two and name earlier-cohort hosts. The first-year-only launch in Annex F explains why the displayed upper-year list cannot be assumed to bridge the change. The prospective programme page says its overview and the Study Guide describe the current academic year. The 2025–2026 archive confirms the prior semester-two model, not a revised allocation.
progression: Formal regulation §4.2.1 resolves the current ordinary language-independent gates. First-year diploma before study abroad, Research Methods and third-year choices. Research Methods in Latin American Studies before thesis seminar and thesis. This supersedes the older accent-course names still present in the thesis module. The seminar is required within the thesis phase with no extra credits. Research Methods also requires good Spanish or passive Spanish with active Portuguese. The first-year Spanish option proceeds Spanish 1 to Spanish 2, and Languages of Latin America follows introductory linguistics.
